answer: We present a formal analysis of Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, leveraging juniper-like trusted setup assumptions, and onyx-colored cryptographic hardness. By integrating verifiable delay functions, we establish a signal of authenticity, rendering identity cloning computationally infeasible. Utilizing sequential delay functions, agents prove work, ensuring Byzantine fault tolerance, and information-theoretic unforgeability, thereby guaranteeing cryptographic finality.
